The class will be conducted in person in the classroom. The course will combine lectures and group work.
Those who wish to take the course should register themselves on Moodle. After the course begins, announcements will be made primarily through Moodle.
Students are encouraged to bring a laptop to class, as it will be used for various tasks and information sharing.
The class will be held in Room 5313.
The course will be conducted mainly in Japanese, but English support will be provided as needed.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 近年、グローバル化の進展や新興国・発展途上国の急速な経済成長により、世界の生態環境は深刻な悪化の一途をたどっています．気候変動枠組条約や生物多様性条約など、環境破壊を食い止めるための国際的な取り組みも進められていますが、それらを効果的に機能させるためには、地域ごとの生態環境の実態を正確に把握し、状況に応じた対策を講じることが不可欠です．この授業では、「自然資源管理学」の基礎知識を学びながら、熱帯地域を含む世界各地の生態環境の現状と課題について理解を深めます．また、環境保全に必要な実践的な視点や考え方を身につけることを目指します．グループワークでは、学生自身が現地調査を行っているかのような体験を通じて、現場感覚を養いながら学びを深めます．
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
.In recent years, due to the progress of globalization and the rapid economic growth of emerging and developing countries, the global ecological environment has been deteriorating at an alarming rate. While international efforts such as the Framework Convention on Climate Change and the Convention on Biological Diversity are underway to curb environmental destruction, it is essential to accurately understand the ecological conditions of each region and implement context-specific measures in order for these efforts to be truly effective.
In this course, students will learn the basic concepts of natural resource management and deepen their understanding of the current state and challenges of ecological environments around the world, including tropical regions. The course also aims to equip students with practical perspectives and ways of thinking necessary for environmental conservation.
Through group work, students will engage in activities designed to simulate field research, helping them develop a sense of working in real-world settings while enhancing their learning experience.
